verses.sloka: ततः प्रवृत्तं सुक्रूरं रामरावणयोस्तदा ।सुमहद्द्वैरथं युद्धं सर्वलोकभयावहम् ।। ६.१०९.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pravṛttaṁ sukrūraṁ rāmarāvaṇayostadā ।sumahaddvairathaṁ yuddhaṁ sarvalokabhayāvaham ।। 6.109.1 ।।

translations.english: Then there ensued a fierce duel between Rama and Ravana that was fearsome to the whole world.
translations.hindi: बलवान्‌ रावण द्वारा रद्ध में शक्ति के प्रहार से गिरे हुए शूर- वीर लक्ष्मण जी को रुधिर में सराबोर देख कर भी, दुरात्मा रावण के साथ घोर संग्राम कर ओर बाणा को छोड़ते हुए, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी सुषेण ( वानरय्‌ थपति ) से बोले

verses.sloka: ततो राक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम् ।प्रगृहीतप्रहरणं निश्चेष्टं समतिष्ठत ।। ६.१०९.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato rākṣasasainyaṁ ca harīṇāṁ ca mahadbalam ।pragṛhītapraharaṇaṁ niśceṣṭaṁ samatiṣṭhata ।। 6.109.2 ।।

translations.english: Then, both Rakshasa army and huge Vanara army, stood motionless holding their weapons ready.

verses.sloka: सम्प्रयुद्धौ ततो दृष्ट्वा बलवन्नरराक्षसौ ।व्याक्षिप्तहृदयाः सर्वे परं विस्मयमागताः ।। ६.१०९.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: samprayuddhau tato dṛṣṭvā balavannararākṣasau ।vyākṣiptahṛdayāḥ sarve paraṁ vismayamāgatāḥ ।। 6.109.3 ।।

translations.english: Then, when the mighty human and the Rakshasa were both engaged in the battle, distracted at heart, all experienced supreme wonderment.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण का, इस रावण की शक्ति के आघात से प्रथिवी पर गिरना ओर साँप की तरह लोटना देख सुझको शोकान्वित करता है

verses.sloka: नानाप्रहरणैर्व्यग्रैर्भुजैर्विस्मितबुद्धयः ।सर्पन्तं प्रेक्ष्य सङ्ग्रामं नाभिजग्मुः परस्परम् ।। ६.१०९.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: nānāpraharaṇairvyagrairbhujairvismitabuddhayaḥ ।sarpantaṁ prekṣya saṅgrāmaṁ nābhijagmuḥ parasparam ।। 6.109.4 ।।

translations.english: All the army on both sides lifted their hands up, holding different kinds of implements, and were amazed looking at them and did not attack one another.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण मझे अपने प्राणों से भी अधिक प्यारे हैं । ये लोहू में नहाये हुए हें । इनको इस दशा में देख, में घबडा गया हूँ । अब मुझ में क्या शक्ति है, जो में बे से लड़ सकू

verses.sloka: रक्षसां रावणं चापि वानराणां च राघवम् ।पश्यतां विस्मिताक्षाणां सैन्यं चित्रमिवाबभौ ।। ६.१०९.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: rakṣasāṁ rāvaṇaṁ cāpi vānarāṇāṁ ca rāghavam ।paśyatāṁ vismitākṣāṇāṁ sainyaṁ citramivābabhau ।। 6.109.5 ।।

translations.english: The army of Rakshasas was looking at Ravana and the Vanaras were looking at Raghava with astonishment as though it was a wonderful picture.
translations.hindi: यदि शुभ लक्षणों से युक्त यह मेरा समरश्लाघी भाई कहीं सर गया, तो फिर सुखमोगने से मुके लाभ ही क्या हे ?

verses.sloka: तौ तु तत्र निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा रावणराघवौ ।कृतबुद्धी स्थिरामर्षौ युयुधाते ब्यभीतवत् ।। ६.१०९.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tau tu tatra nimittāni dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇarāghavau ।kṛtabuddhī sthirāmarṣau yuyudhāte byabhītavat ।। 6.109.6 ।।

translations.english: Both Ravana and Rama, seeing their portents, firmly resolved in mind with indignation, fought fearlessly.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्डे इनकी यह दशा देख मुझे श्रपने बल .पराक्रम पर लञ्जा आती है! हाथ से धनुष कूटा पड़ता हे । वाण ढोले पड़ गए हैं और आखा म बराबर आँझुझ के उमडने से धुके कुछ दिखलाई भी नही पड़ता

verses.sloka: जेतव्यमिति काकुत्स्थो मर्तव्यमिति रावणः ।धृतौ स्ववीर्यसर्वस्वं युद्धे ऽदर्शयतां तदा ।। ६.१०९.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: jetavyamiti kākutstho martavyamiti rāvaṇaḥ ।dhṛtau svavīryasarvasvaṁ yuddhe 'darśayatāṁ tadā ।। 6.109.7 ।।

translations.english: Kakuthsa Rama, sure of his victory and Ravana thinking surely of his death, exhibited their prowess totally in the battle, with determination.
translations.hindi: दुरात्मा रावण द्वारा भाई को मारा गया देख, स्वप्न में गमन करने वाले मनुष्य को तरह मेरे पैर आगे न पड़ कर पीछे को पड़ते हैं । मेरी चिन्ता उग्ररूप धारण कर, उत्तरोत्तर बढ़ती ही अली जाती है ओर जी चाहता हे कि, इस लोक ही को त्याग दे (अर्थात्‌ मर जाऊ )

verses.sloka: ततः क्रोधाद्दशग्रीवः शरान् सन्धाय वीर्यवान् ।मुमोच ध्वजमुद्दिश्य राघवस्य रथे स्थितम् ।। ६.१०९.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ krodhāddaśagrīvaḥ śarān sandhāya vīryavān ।mumoca dhvajamuddiśya rāghavasya rathe sthitam ।। 6.109.8 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, valiant ten headed Ravana, fixing arrows released them in anger aiming at the flag post of Rama's chariot.

verses.sloka: ते शरास्तमनासाद्य पुरन्दररथध्वजम् ।रथशक्तिं परामृश्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले ।। ६.१०९.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: te śarāstamanāsādya purandararathadhvajam ।rathaśaktiṁ parāmṛśya nipeturdharaṇītale ।। 6.109.9 ।।

translations.english: Those arrows, without reaching the post on Indra's chariot, touching the chariot fell on ground.

verses.sloka: ततो रामो ऽभिसङ्क्रुद्धश्चापमायम्य वीर्यवान् ।कृतप्रतिकृतं कर्तुं मनसा सम्प्रचक्रमे ।। ६.१०९.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato rāmo 'bhisaṅkruddhaścāpamāyamya vīryavān ।kṛtapratikṛtaṁ kartuṁ manasā sampracakrame ।। 6.109.10 ।।

translations.english: Valiant Rama too stretching his bow in anger and thinking of returning back blow to Ravana and started compliance.

verses.sloka: रावणध्वजमुद्दिश्य मुमोच निशितं शरम् ।महासर्पमिवासह्यं ज्वलन्तं स्वेन तेजसा ।। ६.१०९.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇadhvajamuddiśya mumoca niśitaṁ śaram ।mahāsarpamivāsahyaṁ jvalantaṁ svena tejasā ।। 6.109.11 ।।

translations.english: Rama, intolerant like a snake, targeting Ravana's post, released a sharp bright glowing arrow.
translations.hindi: मरे हुए लक्ष्मण को समरभूमि में धूल में पड़ा देख, मैं अब अयोध्या का राज्य लेकर और जी कर हो क्या करूँ गा ? मुझे अब रावण से लड़ने की भी आवश्यकता नहीं है

verses.sloka: जगाम स महीं छित्त्वा दशग्रीवध्वजं शरः ।स निकृत्तो ऽपतद्भूमौ रावणस्य रथध्वजः ।। ६.१०९.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: jagāma sa mahīṁ chittvā daśagrīvadhvajaṁ śaraḥ ।sa nikṛtto 'patadbhūmau rāvaṇasya rathadhvajaḥ ।। 6.109.12 ।।

translations.english: Glorious Rama aiming at the flag post of Ravana, released an arrow that tore the post and went into the ground.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि, लक्ष्मण तो समरच्तेत्र में अब सदा के लिए सो ही गए हैं । देखो स्रिया और भाई बन्धु तो सब जगह मिल सकते हैं,

verses.sloka: ध्वजस्योन्मथनं दृष्ट्वा रावणः सुमहाबलः ।सम्प्रदीप्तो ऽभवत् क्रोधादमर्षात् प्रदहन्निव ।। ६.१०९.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhvajasyonmathanaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaḥ sumahābalaḥ ।sampradīpto 'bhavat krodhādamarṣāt pradahanniva ।। 6.109.13 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's flag post fell down, struck by Rama. Mighty Ravana, observing his post being struck, became intolerant, and burning in anger, laughing, rained showers of arrows at Rama out of fury.
translations.hindi: परन्तु मुके ऐसी कोई जगह नहीं देख पड़ती; जहाँ सहोदर भाइ मिल सके । इस प्रकार बिल्लाप करते हुए श्रीरामचन्द्र जी शोक से बिहृल हो घबड़ा गए

verses.sloka: स रोषवशमापन्नः शरवर्षं महद्वमन् ।रामस्य तुरगान् दीप्तैः शरैर्विव्याध रावणः ।। ६.१०९.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa roṣavaśamāpannaḥ śaravarṣaṁ mahadvaman ।rāmasya turagān dīptaiḥ śarairvivyādha rāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.109.14 ।।

translations.english: Ravana's flag post fell down, struck by Rama. Mighty Ravana, observing his post being struck, became intolerant, and burning in anger, laughing, rained showers of arrows at Rama out of fury.

verses.sloka: ते विद्धा हरयस्तत्र नास्खलन्नापि बभ्रमुः ।बभूवुः स्वस्थहृदयाः पद्मनालैरिवाहताः ।। ६.१०९.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: te viddhā harayastatra nāskhalannāpi babhramuḥ ।babhūvuḥ svasthahṛdayāḥ padmanālairivāhatāḥ ।। 6.109.15 ।।

translations.english: Ravana with his burning arrows pierced Rama's horses. Those horses were wonderful as they did not stagger or reel as if hurt by lotus stalks and remained complacent.

verses.sloka: तेषामसम्भ्रमं दृष्ट्वा वाजिनां रावणस्तदा ।भूय एव सुसङ्क्रुद्धः शरवर्षं मुमोच ह ।। ६.१०९.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmasambhramaṁ dṛṣṭvā vājināṁ rāvaṇastadā ।bhūya eva susaṅkruddhaḥ śaravarṣaṁ mumoca ha ।। 6.109.16 ।।

translations.english: Ravana perceived that the horses were just unperturbed by his arrows, became enraged and showered arrows excessively.
translations.hindi: इनका चेहरा तो हर्षित ओर भलीमाँ ति दमक रहा है । इनकी । दोनों हृथेलियाँ कमल-पुष्प को तरह लाल ओर दोनों आँखें सुन्दर बनी हुई हैं

verses.sloka: गदाश्च परिघाश्चैव चक्राणि मुसलानि च ।गिरिशृङ्गाणि वृक्षांश्च तथा शूलपरश्वधान् ।। ६.१०९.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: gadāśca parighāścaiva cakrāṇi musalāni ca ।giriśṛṅgāṇi vṛkṣāṁśca tathā śūlaparaśvadhān ।। 6.109.17 ।।

translations.english: Ravana used maces, iron bars, discuses, clubs, mountain peaks, trees and also tridents and axes.
translations.hindi: हे प्रजापालक ! प्राणहीन लोगों के ऐसे लक्षण नहीं होते । जो मनुष्य दीर्घायु होते हैं, उन्हींका मुख ऐसा हुआ करता है

verses.sloka: मायाविहितमेतत्तु शस्त्रवर्षमपातयत् ।तुमुलं त्रासजननं भीमं भीमप्रतिस्वनम् ।। ६.१०९.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: māyāvihitametattu śastravarṣamapātayat ।tumulaṁ trāsajananaṁ bhīmaṁ bhīmapratisvanam ।। 6.109.18 ।।

translations.english: Unwearied at heart, Ravana let loose rain of arrows created by magic in thousands.

verses.sloka: तद्वर्षमभवद्युद्धे नैकशस्त्रमयं महत् ।विमुच्य राघवरथं समान्ताद्वानरे बले ।। ६.१०९.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadvarṣamabhavadyuddhe naikaśastramayaṁ mahat ।vimucya rāghavarathaṁ samāntādvānare bale ।। 6.109.19 ।।

translations.english: In that war, noisy, alarming, fearful loud noise of weapons of different kinds, in huge numbers, descended.

verses.sloka: सायकैरन्तरिक्षं च चकाराशु निरन्तरम् ।सहस्रशस्ततो बाणानश्रान्तहृदयोद्यमः ।मुमोच च दशग्रीवो निस्सङ्गेना ऽन्तरात्मना ।। ६.१०९.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: sāyakairantarikṣaṁ ca cakārāśu nirantaram ।sahasraśastato bāṇānaśrāntahṛdayodyamaḥ ।mumoca ca daśagrīvo nissaṅgenā 'ntarātmanā ।। 6.109.20 ।।

translations.english: Obstructed by Raghava's chariot on all sides, the arrows covered the Vanara army and up to the sky.
translations.hindi: वाक्यज्ञ सुषेण श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से ये वचन कह कर, हनुमान्‌ जी को जल्दियाते हुए, उनसे बोले

verses.sloka: व्यायच्छमानं तं दृष्ट्वा तत्परं रावणं रणे ।प्रहसन्निव काकुत्स्थः सन्दधे सायकान् शितान् ।। ६.१०९.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: vyāyacchamānaṁ taṁ dṛṣṭvā tatparaṁ rāvaṇaṁ raṇe ।prahasanniva kākutsthaḥ sandadhe sāyakān śitān ।। 6.109.21 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the ten headed Ravana releasing arrows with enthusiasm, not thinking of anything in his mind, quickly Kakuthsa laughed at them, fixed pointed arrows, and released hundreds and thousands.
translations.hindi: हे सौभ्य ! यहाँ से तुम शीक्र जाओ और जाम्बवान्‌ मे जिस बर्चत का पता तुम्हें पहिले बतलाया था, उस 'ओषधिपर्वत पर जा कर

verses.sloka: स मुमोच ततो बाणान् रणे शतसहस्रशः ।तान् दृष्ट्वा रावणश्चक्रे स्वशरैः खं निरन्तरम् ।। ६.१०९.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa mumoca tato bāṇān raṇe śatasahasraśaḥ ।tān dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaścakre svaśaraiḥ khaṁ nirantaram ।। 6.109.22 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the ten headed Ravana releasing arrows with enthusiasm, not thinking of anything in his mind, quickly Kakuthsa laughed at them, fixed pointed arrows, and released hundreds and thousands.
translations.hindi: उस पबत के दक्तिणशिखर पर लगी हुई बूटियों को ले आओ । उन बूटियों में से एक तो घाव सें चुभे हुए बाण आदि को निकालने चाली बिशल्यकरणी नाम को बूटी है

verses.sloka: ततस्ताभ्यां प्रमुक्तेन शरवर्षेण भास्वता ।शरबद्धमिवाभाति द्वितीयं भास्वदम्बरम् ।। ६.१०९.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatastābhyāṁ pramuktena śaravarṣeṇa bhāsvatā ।śarabaddhamivābhāti dvitīyaṁ bhāsvadambaram ।। 6.109.23 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the arrows in the sky released by Rama, even Ravana released arrows up to the sky. With the arrows released by both of them, the space became resplendent and by the network of arrows covering it seemed like another sky.

verses.sloka: नानिमित्तो ऽभवद्बाणो नातिभेत्ता न निष्फलः ।। ६.१०९.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: nānimitto 'bhavadbāṇo nātibhettā na niṣphalaḥ ।। 6.109.24 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the arrows in the sky released by Rama, even Ravana released arrows up to the sky. With the arrows released by both of them, the space became resplendent and by the network of arrows covering it seemed like another sky.

verses.sloka: अन्योन्यमभिसंहत्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले ।तथा विसृजतोर्बाणान् रामरावणयोर्मृधे ।। ६.१०९.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: anyonyamabhisaṁhatya nipeturdharaṇītale ।tathā visṛjatorbāṇān rāmarāvaṇayormṛdhe ।। 6.109.25 ।।

translations.english: The arrows released by both Rama and Ravana were without result. None failed to reach the target. None failed to complete the target. The arrows were colliding with one another and fell on the ground.
translations.hindi: किन्तु वशे जा कर, उन वूटियां को न पहचान सकने के रण वे चिन्तित हुए । तब अमितबलशालो पवननन्दन ने मन मन यह निश्चित किआ कि,

verses.sloka: प्रायुद्ध्यतामविच्छिन्नमस्यन्तौ सव्यदक्षिणम् ।चक्रतुश्च शरौघैस्तौ निरुच्छ्वासमिवाम्बरम् ।। ६.१०९.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: prāyuddhyatāmavicchinnamasyantau savyadakṣiṇam ।cakratuśca śaraughaistau nirucchvāsamivāmbaram ।। 6.109.26 ।।

translations.english: Discharging from right and left, the two heroes without break vehemently released dreadful arrows that covered the sky and left no breathing space between them.
translations.hindi: इसी पर्वतशिखर को उखाड़ कर ले चलें क्यों र शिखर को उ कि, वे सुख- दायिनी बूटियाँ इसी पर तो कहीं लगी हुई हैं.

verses.sloka: रावणस्य हयान् रामो हयान् रामस्य रावणः ।जघ्नतुस्तौ तथा ऽन्योन्यं कृतानुकृतकारिणौ ।। ६.१०९.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya hayān rāmo hayān rāmasya rāvaṇaḥ ।jaghnatustau tathā 'nyonyaṁ kṛtānukṛtakāriṇau ।। 6.109.27 ।।

translations.english: Ravana struck Rama's horses and Rama struck Ravana's horses blow to blow at that time.

verses.sloka: एवं तौ तु सुसङ्क्रुद्धौ चक्रतुर्युद्धमद्भुतम् ।मुहूर्तमभवद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।। ६.१०९.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ tau tu susaṅkruddhau cakraturyuddhamadbhutam ।muhūrtamabhavadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।। 6.109.28 ।।

translations.english: Both became furious in that way and the best duel took place for a moment that was fierce and horipulating.

verses.sloka: प्रयुध्यमानौ समरे महाबलौ शितैः शरै रावणलक्ष्मणाग्रजौ ।ध्वजावपातेन स राक्षसाधिपो भृशं प्रचुक्रोध तदा रघूत्तमे ।। ६.१०९.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: prayudhyamānau samare mahābalau śitaiḥ śarai rāvaṇalakṣmaṇāgrajau ।dhvajāvapātena sa rākṣasādhipo bhṛśaṁ pracukrodha tadā raghūttame ।। 6.109.29 ।।

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे नवोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १०९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe navottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 109 ।।
